privateIntake.evidenceKind: Functional test execution using invented temporary records; not a physical measurement session.
privateIntake.reportPolicy: Private operator report only; source measurements and original labels are excluded from console output and aggregate report.
privateIntake.review: Independent read-only review found no actionable defect; Windows ACL and concurrent filesystem mutation limits are documented.

accuracy.method: Coarse visual estimates on the original synthetic fixture; not surveyed/physical ground truth

pose.limits: Regression run on one synthetic fixture. Frontend type checking ran concurrently for part of the suite. Not a controlled performance comparison, physical camera test, body reconstruction or physical fit benchmark.

limits: The claims reader is contract-backed transport; browser requests used explicit HTTP test doubles, not a live rights backend or resolver.
The shipped scan route remains unconfigured; tag/photo resolution and producer facet mappings are still missing.
Private intake evaluates supplied records without independently verifying their origin, measurements or method.
Tier 2 reconstruction and authenticated fit storage remain unavailable.
No live photo-provider request, physical garment session, native-device session, or deployment is claimed.
The final evidence-only commit retains this implementation; GitHub CI must independently pass before merge.
